answer_1.quote: Poem summarization refers to the process of reducing a poem to its core ideas to provide a concise and informative overview of the content ... Automatic summarization of such creative language can make poetry more accessible to a wider range of audiences and applications ... We have introduced a new task in the field of natural language understanding named 'Poem summarization' ...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the model-generated summaries against the gold reference summaries, we have used the Rouge-1 (R1), Rouge-2 (R2), Rouge-L (RL), and BertScore (BS) metrics.
